**TR-16 complete threshold binding — BLOCKED-SCOPED (audit refresh).** Existing sandbox quality, pressure-ratio/PDR, quantile and hypervolume bindings remain delivered. Full acceptance that every scientific threshold in `evolve.rs` and `experiment.rs` comes from an admitted `requirements/` entry is not met. Beyond the four missing physical pressure/energy/absolute-pressure/duty limits already deferred, the EV-06 executable schema does not expose the current calibration R-squared, reject-split tolerance, ABA replication/power/LCB/effect-margin, holdout-query, bore/metrology and roughness criteria; search significance/audit/bootstrap policy is referenced historically but remains literal. Some criteria have only draft source values or unresolved confidence/replication/relation semantics; others have no admitted source. Prior-model clamps and numerical/search policy are not measured physical limits. Copying these literals into a file would not admit them, and TR selects no replacement values.

To unblock: the requirements/model owners must provide approved content-bound policies with source ID/revision/SHA, observable and units, exact comparison relation, uncertainty/censoring/interval/power method, minimum evidence tier, and applicability/scenario/material/process identities. Resolve the draft-vs-runtime confidence/replication/LCB relation and metrology-band differences explicitly; freeze the historical statistical protocol and versioned prior/numerical model policies separately. Extend EV-06's typed contract, then thread those policies into every affected comparison. Acceptance must enumerate all scientific comparison sites, test each threshold boundary and both relations using the admitted contract, and prove policy/source/unit/objective drift invalidates admission before computation or artifacts. The complete trusted P0 inventory and real independent validation remain mandatory. A same-policy sandbox shard merge must succeed; forged ClaimBearing, mode drift, stale requirement/objective identity, reordered objectives or cleared gate inventory must reject before output, including when the bad shard follows a valid one. These software negative tests are delivered, not physical admission. The earlier TR-16 physical deferral and fail-closed campaign path remain in force.
